reason: Not refuted, but it adds nothing new: R27N-2's freeze item (7) already carries the same rule word for word, and R27N-4 already retries 'until the file's LATE cutoff'. Count its gain once, not twice. VALUE: it is real finals insurance, not a lab or node-count effect. It sends the same confirmed, gated files (stack exp89r/q, exp75, exp89p) later, so the V_pub candidate read and the exp75 private-hedge read (pair A vs B on the card) survive a missed batch. The failure mode is more likely than the claimed 5-10%. round27/scan_plancheck showed that the 15:05-15:35Z 'outage' was Modern Standby on battery with the lid closed; the laptop was on battery (64%) at 15:49Z; and the freeze (23:33Z) and batch (00:04Z) are session-only crons on that laptop. Standby over 00:04Z means the batch fires only when the user wakes the machine in the morning, which is exactly this rule's case. FEASIBILITY: 0 GPU, no code, so it is byte-identical when off and fail-soft. The timing checks out. A CI file sent at 08:30Z reads by 19:24Z at the 10.9 h tail; that is before the 19:30Z card and the 20:00Z tick, but after the 18:37Z FINAL cron. A non-CI file sent at 11:30Z reads by 19:19Z at the 7.81 h tail. The slot count cannot conflict: 3 night + 2 morning = 5, and MORNING TABLE v1.1 (4) already makes a row UNUSED when its input read is missing. R8's 'after 02:00 only emergency repeat, hard edge 10:00' was superseded for 29 Sep files by the user's 10:19Z/10:47Z answers (non-CI by 11:30Z), and the 12:25Z confirmation fixes the files, not a promise that makes the rule post-hoc. GAPS that need fixing: (a) If the 23:30Z freeze was missed too, the text does not say which stack variant to send. A session that wakes up with probe 51 already read could choose exp89r/q after seeing the read. (b) The R18-A7 40-min non-CI spacing is not restated (branch B: exp89q then exp89p). (c) 'Ahead of the morning-table files' could be read as delaying a morning row whose input read exists. (d) The morning message alone is too late, because the user is present at wake.
fix: Merge into R27N-2 freeze item (7) (one rule, not two). Add: (a) If no freeze line was logged, compute probe 51's code with R27N-2 (1)-(2), using only poll headers stamped <= 23:30Z 28 Sep. No such COMPLETE header -> STACK = exp89q (the 12:25Z default). A later read of 51 never changes the variant. (b) LATE non-CI files keep the R18-A7 >= 40-min spacing from the previous non-CI file's actual submit. Order stays stack > exp75 > exp89p (a CI file may go 1 min after a non-CI one). (c) LATE files never delay a morning-table row whose input read is present. The 5/day count is not binding, so 'ahead' means only that a LATE file is sent before any morning row is evaluated. (d) When the rule fires, push the user at once (PushNotification, MSK first) and log a CONTEXT line 'LATE: <file> sent <UTC> (reason: standby/network/session)'. (e) Keep it secondary to the plancheck power fix (charger in, lid-close = do nothing); check at 23:25Z that the laptop is on AC.
realistic_gain: About 0 expected score. It is insurance: it fires with an estimated ~5-15% chance (higher if the laptop stays on battery or the lid gets closed). When it fires, it keeps 3 finals-relevant reads (exp75 private-hedge pairing, worth a few 1e-4 private per mc26; and the stack's chance, ~25-35%, of a +0.001 public V_pub). EV about +0.00002-0.00005, at zero GPU and slot cost. Its gain is already counted under R27N-2 (7) and must not be counted twice.
